description.narrative: IFC is proposing to provide a senior A-loan of up to US$20mn (the IFC Loan) to fund Novatexs working capital requirements for import of raw materials, machinery, and related services to support the Companys existing operations (the Project). IFC will also play a catalyst role and mobilize parallel loans of up to US$40mn in LCY (the Parallel Loan)

The Project is expected to help sustain Company's on-going operations allowing it to continue to support economic activity, preserve jobs and build capacity in its supply chain (local sugarcane farmers, MSME retailers, and distributors etc) to withstand shocks and stresses arising from COVID-19's disruption of supply chains and rising inflation.
